item.title: Gaza runs out of cancer medicines, as Israeli strikes continue
item.description: Officials at Gaza’s Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital say cancer medicines have completely run out, as Israeli strikes continue.

item.title: Algeria wildfire death toll expected to rise as survivors say nothing left
item.description: Algeria says at least 12 people have been killed in wildfires sweeping the northeast, with the toll expected to rise.

item.title: Can international diplomacy find a way forward in Libya?
item.description: Efforts intensify to break political impasse in a divided country.

item.title: The rise of K-Beauty: Can South Korea overtake France?
item.description: South Korea’s beauty industry has surpassed the US to become the world’s second-largest cosmetics exporter.

item.title: US says far-right provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported to UK
item.description: The social media personality had been detained by immigration agents at an airport in New Orleans earlier in the week.

item.title: Tunisians desperate for water as taps run dry
item.description: Tunisians are struggling to access water as extreme heat, power cuts, and aging infrastructure disrupt tap supplies.

item.title: US judge rules against Trump’s effort to deport pro-Palestinian students
item.description: A federal judge criticised the Trump government for attempting to infringe upon foreign students' rights to free speech.

item.title: Haitian gangs release 13 captives after mass kidnapping in Kenscoff
item.description: The attack in Kenscoff killed at least 47 people and resulted in the kidnapping of more than 50, as gangs exert control.

item.title: Pakistan suspends eight officials over hospital fire that killed 14 babies
item.description: Interim inquiry finds lack of fire safety protocols at Islamabad hospital, prompting suspensions and criminal probe.

item.title: DR Congo begins vaccinating against largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak
item.description: 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses have been sent to DR Congo in hope they prove effective against the Bundibugyo strain.

item.title: Sudan’s date palm trees under threat from drought and wildfires
item.description: In Sudan, date palm trees are an economic lifeline for residents of Northern State.

item.title: Turkiye summons Ukraine ambassador over Black Sea attacks
item.description: Two Turkish-operated vessels have been struck this week as a result of the war between Russia and Ukraine.

item.title: Israeli army arrests six Palestinians after settler violence in West Bank
item.description: Israeli settlers stormed Qusra in the occupied West Bank, attacking Palestinian residents and damaging homes.

item.title: Niger military says it is regaining control after attempted mutiny
item.description: Niger’s military says it is regaining control after a mutiny in Niamey after gun fire was heard in the capital.

item.title: Russian strike on a munitions depot triggers deadly blasts near Kyiv
item.description: Russian strike on an arms depot near Kyiv sparked fires and explosions, killing at least 38 people and wounding dozens.

item.title: RSS chief’s visit to US denounced as ‘goodwill tour’ for Hindu nationalism
item.description: Activists say Hindu nationalists have sought to mask far-right politics through broad appeals to the Indian diaspora.

item.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza kill four people, hit hospital supply warehouse
item.description: Gaza’s Health Ministry reports rising casualties amid escalated Israeli attacks, with victims trapped under rubble.

item.title: Man United vs Ipswich Town: Premier League – preview, team news, prediction
item.description: United put in a sorry display as they lost 2-0 to Hull last weekend, while newly promoted Ipswich beat Sunderland 2-1.

item.title: Liverpool net late in Forest draw to avoid Anfield debut defeat for Iraola
item.description: Victor Munoz scores late goal to secure 2-2 draw for Liverpool after Nottingham Forest scare in Premier League.

item.title: People stranded for days on dilapidated Nigerian highway
item.description: Al Jazeera asked people on the Benin-Agbor-Asaba road how they view this infrastructure crisis.

item.title: Korea divided: A sister’s long wait and a defector’s bid to save his mother
item.description: An elderly South Korean waits to see a brother in the North one last time, while a North Korean defector risks it all.

item.title: Mladic died a happy man. He won
item.description: He fought for fascism to triumph. And it did.

item.title: Israeli settlers surround Palestinian home in occupied West Bank’s Qusra
item.description: At least four people trapped inside their home, as earlier siege on Palestinian families has continued for three weeks.

item.title: Chinese rescuers race to reach mudslide survivors in Nepal-China border
item.description: Rescuers raced to clear roads leading to the mudslide-hit border port of Gyirong, China's Tibet Autonomous Region.

item.title: Israel raids, shutters UNRWA lifeline for Palestinian refugees
item.description: An UNRWA vocational centre in the occupied West Bank has been raided by Israeli forces and ordered to close.
